irregularities.description: Sandbox egress restriction: direct HTTPS from the build sandbox cannot reach api.elections.kalshi.com (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL on connect; DNS resolves), while github.com/api.github.com are reachable. Evidence collection in this session therefore goes through the platform's server-side fetch route; every collected file records the tool used in its provenance sidecar and is SHA-256 bound, so the bytes are identical regardless of route. The GitHub Actions collector (forward-desk.yml) runs on runners with normal egress and is the permanent route.
irregularities.detail: Re-verified per cycle by scripts/probe_endpoints.py in CI; if the official API moves hosts, the publish job fails rather than publishing unverified data.
irregularities.status: environmental - no action for data integrity

irregularities.description: The platform fetch proxy failed intermittently during this session with server-side OSS errors (InvalidAccessKeyId on the proxy's own storage), returning error XML instead of the target response. Mitigation: only successful responses with parsable JSON bodies are ever committed; failed responses are retried, and a failure is never written into the evidence directories.
irregularities.detail: If collection stalls, the season board simply shows fewer cycles — no data integrity risk because nothing downstream reads failed payloads.

irregularities.description: The CandleCharts contest page (specials.candlecharts.com/contest) was cited from the project brief and a search result but not fully retrieved this session; only its existence as a paper-contest reference is recorded.
irregularities.detail: Flagged so the citation is not mistaken for a read source. CI link probe (scripts/probe_links.py) reports reachability; a full read is queued for the next session.

master_site_projects.name: Commodities — Kalshi Research Exchange
master_site_projects.relevance: Sister project: automated forward-test desk for Kalshi event contracts. Referenced line by line in this session for the exchange's documented mechanics (reciprocal quoting, quadratic taker fee, settlement semantics, evidence-first cycle design). PRICINGEXPERT's competition model (per-year seasons, username personas, max-return ranking) is an independent implementation.

master_site_projects.name: MLBComp — Auditable MLB Research & Paper Competition
master_site_projects.relevance: Reference for the research->discover->verify->model->backtest->forward-test loop and for the 'verified timestamped quote before anything is staked' gate. Its withdrawn-fabricated-data episode (IRR-64/IRR-72 in the MasterSite) is the cautionary pattern this project's hash-bound evidence design avoids.

master_site_projects.name: DrugAnalysis — FDA Decisions & Biotech Reactions
master_site_projects.relevance: Reference for event-timing research methodology: official decision timestamps (openFDA) joined to verified price reactions, with every row carrying payload file + SHA. The same pattern applies to Kalshi: official settlement/release timestamps vs captured market quotes.
